description: Today's PromptExperiment rule (UCB1 assignment; a winner at >= 10 trials per arm, effect >= 0.1, and chi-squared p < 0.05 or disjoint Wilson 95% intervals after >= 50 trials) on seeded A/A sequences, captured before backlog 5118 replaces it. Variant i is v{i}. Outcome t is a success when splitmix64(seed)'s t-th draw, (x >> 11) * 2^-53, is below p, whichever arm runs. concluded_at counts the outcomes recorded when record_outcome returned true; null means no winner within the horizon.
